name: StableMagnet
rootCause: The BSC on-chain project StableMagnet ran away and lost USD 24 million. On August 12, the Greater Manchester Police Department announced that it had arrested the suspects of the StableMagnet Finance team who had previously taken away $22 million of users on the BSC. The police found a large amount of stolen Ethereum in the encrypted U disk. descriptions.text: A few hours before the attack, we received a message from an anonymous source suggesting that StableMagnet would rugpull. We couldn’t verify the claims, so our hands were tied.

The BSC on-chain project StableMagnet ran away and lost USD 24 million. On August 12, the Greater Manchester Police Department announced that it had arrested the suspects of the StableMagnet Finance team who had previously taken away $22 million of users on the BSC. The police found a large amount of stolen Ethereum in the encrypted U disk. According to statistics, this money accounted for 90%($ 22,250,000) of the stolen cryptocurrency, and it is now beginning to reconnect with the legitimate owner.

The StableMagnet protocol on BNB Chain was drained of approximately $27 million on 23,24 June 2021 after its core contracts included a hidden backdoor in an unverified linked library, enabling team-controlled theft of both liquidity pool funds and user wallets with active approvals. A malicious, unverified smart contract library (SwapUtils) was deployed in place of the version seen by users and auditors. This hidden backdoor allowed the StableMagnet team to drain contract and user funds at will.
